title: Prometheus learning envelope
description: Metadata every lesson, gotcha, decision, progress record or candidate carries when the pack writes it to surreal-memory, pk or the Karpathy logs. It lets recall deliver each lesson only to the agents it is directed to. See docs/design/team-aware-learning-memory.md.

projectId.description: Resolved by the single project-id resolver: PROMETHEUS_PROJECT_ID, then .prometheus/project.json projectId, then the runtime-registered project UUID, then project:<sha256(git common dir)>.

teamId.description: agent-team id when the author resolves to a team role.

roleId.description: role id within teamId; the native agent name with any <plugin>: prefix stripped.

visibility.description: Who may receive the lesson. Default agent (private to the authoring role). role:<r> and lead are addressed deliveries; team, project, user and global are promoted scopes.

audience.description: Additional addressed recipients. Each produces one stored copy keyed to that recipient.

paths.description: Repository-relative paths the lesson concerns; used to route it to the roles that own them.

agentId.description: harness agent_id when written from a subagent.

agentType.description: harness agent_type as reported, before normalisation.

contentHash.description: sha256 of the normalised lesson text; recall de-duplicates on it.
